correctness.rationale: Invertibility of T gives [L_T,L_T]=V and center zero. Every automorphism preserves V and has e↦ae+w and restriction S, with bracket condition ST=aTS. The determinant of the triangular matrix of φ−I is (a−1)det(S−I), so w is unrestricted. The intertwiner maps the λ-primary space onto the λ/a-primary space, preserving the block sizes because the nilpotent parts differ only by multiplication by a unit. Each chosen map between those spaces ranges over a torsor for a module-centralizer unit group. On each eigenvalue module, a map from length i to length j needs a factor u^max(j−i,0), giving min(i,j) independent coefficients. The same-length constant matrices define a surjective algebra map to the product of full matrix rings. Its kernel is nilpotent: a kernel transition either picks up a factor u or strictly decreases block length, so if K is the maximum length, every product of K² kernel maps vanishes. Consequently a unit and the unit test on P−I are determined in that quotient, with equal-size fibers. Subspace Möbius inversion divided by |GL_d| gives the stated δ_q(d), since the expected number of pointwise-fixed r-dimensional subspaces is 1/|GL_r| by transitivity on ordered independent r-tuples. A vector fixed by cyclic S is uniquely propagated from a fixed vector of its return map; choosing all but the last link makes the return map run exactly once through the module-centralizer unit group. Choices from different orbits are independent. This gives the count, proportion and total. For q=2 only a=1 is available; for q>2 a nonidentity scalar times the identity in each return quotient shows positivity in every available a≠1 sector. Independent bounded module enumerations over F_3 gave 18 good cyclic pairs out of 36 for paired J_2 and 2916 out of 11664 for paired type (2,1), hence fixed-point-free Lie counts 1458 and 2125764, and total counts 5832 and 17006112. These checks can be replayed by enumerating the entries of X,Y over F_3, retaining invertible links with X T_1=2 T_2 X and Y T_2=2 T_1 Y, and rejecting pairs with det(YX−I)=0. The frozen verifier was inspected, not executed.
residual_risks: Independent enumeration covers the specified small prime-field modules, not arbitrary extension fields. The module proof uses only operations over the base field and establishes the general prime-power statement; nonsplit and noninvertible T are excluded.

value.rationale: The formula gives an exact census rather than just an existence test on a natural class of finite Lie algebras. It explains why equal eigenvalue multiplicities can still give different outcomes: scalar compatibility and return-map exclusion detect the full Jordan partitions. The nonsemisimple probability and count therefore add a usable invariant beyond the earlier diagonalizable case and complex existence criterion.
residual_risks: The value assessment excludes the already covered diagonalizable specialization and does not claim a nonsplit or singular extension, or exact fixed-space dimensions beyond zero.
